response.rationale: A and B overlap but are not quite the same capability. Both rest on the same code, DropTextClient (node 0e0ffaf33c6872c8). A (community:1) groups IceMonitorService (node f59a45a01c2ed338, domain layer, fan-out 10) with DropTextClient and IceStateRepository. Its label and grouping point to a specific business process: ice-state monitoring places sessions on hold and customers are texted about it. This reading comes from the names and grouping, not from code shown. B covers only DropTextClient, an infrastructure-layer class with no outgoing dependencies inside the persistence component. That makes B a general text-messaging channel with no business trigger. A uses the channel B describes, so they differ in scope. Confidence is moderate because B could be read as a coarser label for the same thing, since both share the same client.
